description: This PHP class 'ConsoleProjectListener' handles project lifecycle events such as failure, completion of first and second rounds, and success, generating feeds and sending notifications accordingly.

classes.name: ConsoleProjectListener
classes.description: Handles project-related events such as failure, success, and round progression, generating feeds and notifications.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, warning if duplicate, otherwise notices.

methods.name: onProjectFailed
methods.description: Handles actions when a project fails, including archiving, feed creation, and notifications.

methods.name: onProjectOneRound
methods.description: Handles actions when a project completes its first round, marking success, creating feeds, and notifications.

methods.name: onProjectRound1
methods.description: Handles actions when a project passes the first round, marking progress, creating feeds, and notifications.

methods.name: onProjectRound2
methods.description: Handles actions when a project passes the second round, marking success, creating feeds, and notifications.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to.
